mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and depressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 120), a subsequent INDPRO decline signals supply chain disruption, reducing corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 120 and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 grows, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low housing demand regimes (HOUST < 1800), a further HOUST decline signals deepening housing sector weakness, reducing consumer wealth and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1800 and HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
